text.en:
In the headings of Title Four of Book One of the Revised Penal Code, strike out the words "and
of civil liability resulting from crime"; strike out also the words "Chapter One-Extinction of criminal
liability"; and amend the words "Section One" and "Section Two" to read, respectively, "Chapter One" and
"Chapter Two."

This Act shall take effect on its approval.
Approved, December 7, 1933.
